data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

ui_devex.name: rtk
ui_devex.summary: rtk 是一个轻量级 CLI 代理，能将常见开发命令中的 LLM token 消耗降低 60-90%，让 AI 编程助手更经济高效。其核心设计在于拦截工具调用、去重上下文并智能缓存响应，所有功能集成在单个 Rust 二进制文件中，无任何外部依赖。开发者只需将其接入 Claude Code 等现有工具，即可在不影响质量的前提下大幅削减成本。特别适合频繁进行代码审查、重构或调试的团队，是优化 AI 辅助开发流程的实用利器。
ui_devex.summary_en: rtk is a CLI proxy that slashes LLM token usage by 60-90% on common developer commands, making AI coding assistants cheaper and faster. It intercepts tool calls, deduplicates context, and caches responses efficiently—all in a single Rust binary with zero dependencies. Developers can drop it into their existing workflow with Claude Code or similar tools to cut costs without sacrificing quality. Ideal for teams running frequent code reviews, refactoring, or debugging sessions.

ui_devex.name: erpnext
ui_devex.summary: ERPNext 是一款免费开源的企业资源计划（ERP）系统，覆盖会计、人力资源、制造、客户关系管理、采购、销售点等核心业务模块。它基于 Frappe 框架构建，采用模块化架构，支持通过 Python 和 JavaScript 轻松定制和扩展，无需修改核心代码即可添加自定义字段、表单和工作流。你可以用它来统一管理从销售、库存到薪资、项目的全流程业务，完全掌控数据和业务流程。对于中小企业或希望摆脱商业 ERP 锁定的团队，ERPNext 提供了强大且灵活的替代方案。
ui_devex.summary_en: ERPNext is a free, open-source ERP system covering accounting, HR, manufacturing, CRM, and more. Its modular architecture on the Frappe framework allows easy customization and extension via Python and JavaScript. Use it to manage your entire business operations—from sales and inventory to payroll and projects—with full control over data and workflows.

ui_devex.name: PhotoGIMP
ui_devex.summary: PhotoGIMP 是针对 GIMP 3+ 的补丁，旨在帮助 Photoshop 用户无缝迁移至开源图像编辑工具。它通过重新排列菜单、快捷键和工具布局模拟 Photoshop 界面，并预装常用字体与笔刷，显著降低学习成本。技术核心在于修改 GIMP 配置文件，无需编译源码即可一键应用。用户只需将补丁文件复制至配置目录并重启，即可获得熟悉操作体验。适合希望摆脱商业软件依赖的设计师、教育机构或工作室，尤其便于团队批量部署。用户可基于此思路进一步自定义快捷键或菜单，打造专属工作流。
ui_devex.summary_en: PhotoGIMP is a patch that adapts GIMP 3+ to feel like Adobe Photoshop, reducing the learning curve for Photoshop users migrating to open-source tools. It rearranges menus, shortcuts, and tool layouts to mirror Photoshop's interface, while adding default resources like fonts and brushes. This makes GIMP immediately usable for Photoshop veterans without retraining. You can apply it by copying the patch files into your GIMP configuration folder, instantly transforming the UI. It's ideal for designers, educators, or studios transitioning to free software.

ui_devex.name: ViMax
ui_devex.summary: ViMax是一个集导演、编剧、制片人和视频生成于一体的智能体视频生成框架，旨在解决从简单提示生成连贯故事视频的难题。其核心技术采用多智能体架构，通过专门化的智能体分别负责剧情规划、脚本编写和画面渲染，实现复杂叙事生成。用户输入文本提示或故事大纲后，ViMax可自动生成包含场景切换和角色一致的完整视频。该工具特别适合快速制作视频原型或教育叙事内容，使非专业用户也能轻松创作高质量视频故事。
ui_devex.summary_en: ViMax is an all-in-one agentic video generation framework that combines director, screenwriter, producer, and video generator roles into a single system. It addresses the challenge of producing coherent, story-driven videos from simple prompts. Technically, it uses a multi-agent architecture where specialized agents handle planning, scripting, and rendering, enabling complex narrative generation. You can experiment with it by providing a text prompt or story outline, and ViMax will autonomously produce a complete video with scene transitions and consistent characters. Ideal for rapid prototyping of video content or educational storytelling.

agents_workflows.name: agency-agents
agents_workflows.summary: Agency-agents是一个开源框架，旨在简化多智能体AI系统的构建。它通过提供预配置的专用智能体，解决协调多样化AI能力的复杂性。每个智能体具有独特的个性和处理流程，支持模块化协作，适用于前端开发、内容审核等特定任务。开发者可通过API快速部署智能体，定制现有智能体以适应新领域，或组合它们构建复杂工作流。该框架适用于自动化多步骤、多专业知识项目，鼓励用户创建智能体团队解决实际问题。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Agency-agents is an open-source framework that simplifies building multi-agent AI systems by providing pre-configured specialized agents, addressing the complexity of coordinating diverse AI capabilities. Its key insight is structuring agents with distinct personalities and processes, enabling modular collaboration where each agent handles specific tasks like frontend development or content moderation. Developers can deploy these agents via the provided API, customize existing agents for new domains, or combine them to create complex workflows, making it practical for automating multi-step projects requiring varied expertise.

agents_workflows.name: rtk
agents_workflows.summary: rtk 是一个轻量级 CLI 代理，能将常见开发命令中的 LLM token 消耗降低 60-90%，让 AI 编程助手更经济高效。其核心设计在于拦截工具调用、去重上下文并智能缓存响应，所有功能集成在单个 Rust 二进制文件中，无任何外部依赖。开发者只需将其接入 Claude Code 等现有工具，即可在不影响质量的前提下大幅削减成本。特别适合频繁进行代码审查、重构或调试的团队，是优化 AI 辅助开发流程的实用利器。
agents_workflows.summary_en: rtk is a CLI proxy that slashes LLM token usage by 60-90% on common developer commands, making AI coding assistants cheaper and faster. It intercepts tool calls, deduplicates context, and caches responses efficiently—all in a single Rust binary with zero dependencies. Developers can drop it into their existing workflow with Claude Code or similar tools to cut costs without sacrificing quality. Ideal for teams running frequent code reviews, refactoring, or debugging sessions.

agents_workflows.name: erpnext
agents_workflows.summary: ERPNext 是一款免费开源的企业资源计划（ERP）系统，覆盖会计、人力资源、制造、客户关系管理、采购、销售点等核心业务模块。它基于 Frappe 框架构建，采用模块化架构，支持通过 Python 和 JavaScript 轻松定制和扩展，无需修改核心代码即可添加自定义字段、表单和工作流。你可以用它来统一管理从销售、库存到薪资、项目的全流程业务，完全掌控数据和业务流程。对于中小企业或希望摆脱商业 ERP 锁定的团队，ERPNext 提供了强大且灵活的替代方案。
agents_workflows.summary_en: ERPNext is a free, open-source ERP system covering accounting, HR, manufacturing, CRM, and more. Its modular architecture on the Frappe framework allows easy customization and extension via Python and JavaScript. Use it to manage your entire business operations—from sales and inventory to payroll and projects—with full control over data and workflows.

agents_workflows.summary: ViMax是一个集导演、编剧、制片人和视频生成于一体的智能体视频生成框架，旨在解决从简单提示生成连贯故事视频的难题。其核心技术采用多智能体架构，通过专门化的智能体分别负责剧情规划、脚本编写和画面渲染，实现复杂叙事生成。用户输入文本提示或故事大纲后，ViMax可自动生成包含场景切换和角色一致的完整视频。该工具特别适合快速制作视频原型或教育叙事内容，使非专业用户也能轻松创作高质量视频故事。
agents_workflows.summary_en: ViMax is an all-in-one agentic video generation framework that combines director, screenwriter, producer, and video generator roles into a single system. It addresses the challenge of producing coherent, story-driven videos from simple prompts. Technically, it uses a multi-agent architecture where specialized agents handle planning, scripting, and rendering, enabling complex narrative generation. You can experiment with it by providing a text prompt or story outline, and ViMax will autonomously produce a complete video with scene transitions and consistent characters. Ideal for rapid prototyping of video content or educational storytelling.

framework_core.name: ViMax
framework_core.summary: ViMax是一个集导演、编剧、制片人和视频生成于一体的智能体视频生成框架，旨在解决从简单提示生成连贯故事视频的难题。其核心技术采用多智能体架构，通过专门化的智能体分别负责剧情规划、脚本编写和画面渲染，实现复杂叙事生成。用户输入文本提示或故事大纲后，ViMax可自动生成包含场景切换和角色一致的完整视频。该工具特别适合快速制作视频原型或教育叙事内容，使非专业用户也能轻松创作高质量视频故事。
framework_core.summary_en: ViMax is an all-in-one agentic video generation framework that combines director, screenwriter, producer, and video generator roles into a single system. It addresses the challenge of producing coherent, story-driven videos from simple prompts. Technically, it uses a multi-agent architecture where specialized agents handle planning, scripting, and rendering, enabling complex narrative generation. You can experiment with it by providing a text prompt or story outline, and ViMax will autonomously produce a complete video with scene transitions and consistent characters. Ideal for rapid prototyping of video content or educational storytelling.

optimization_compilers.name: rtk
optimization_compilers.summary: rtk 是一个轻量级 CLI 代理，能将常见开发命令中的 LLM token 消耗降低 60-90%，让 AI 编程助手更经济高效。其核心设计在于拦截工具调用、去重上下文并智能缓存响应，所有功能集成在单个 Rust 二进制文件中，无任何外部依赖。开发者只需将其接入 Claude Code 等现有工具，即可在不影响质量的前提下大幅削减成本。特别适合频繁进行代码审查、重构或调试的团队，是优化 AI 辅助开发流程的实用利器。
optimization_compilers.summary_en: rtk is a CLI proxy that slashes LLM token usage by 60-90% on common developer commands, making AI coding assistants cheaper and faster. It intercepts tool calls, deduplicates context, and caches responses efficiently—all in a single Rust binary with zero dependencies. Developers can drop it into their existing workflow with Claude Code or similar tools to cut costs without sacrificing quality. Ideal for teams running frequent code reviews, refactoring, or debugging sessions.
